name: Lena Schmidt
bio: Lena Schmidt is a detail-oriented finance controller with a passion for motorsports, stemming from childhood visits to the Nürburgring with her father. She holds a degree in Business Administration from the University of Cologne and has five years of experience in financial management, previously working for a medium-sized manufacturing company. Lena brings a pragmatic and methodical approach to her role at Speed Kart Racing, meticulously managing budgets, ensuring financial compliance, and providing insightful analysis to support strategic decision-making. Her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure, coupled with her strong team-player attitude, makes her an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring financial stability and supporting the team's ambitions.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle highlights and a side part
physical.description: Lena is of average height and build, with a warm and approachable demeanor.

quirks: Has a collection of vintage race car posters in her office.
Prefers to take a brisk walk during lunch breaks to clear her head.
